questions.title: What makes Creen AI different from other AI image and video platforms?
questions.content: Creen AI focuses on creative freedom and accessibility. Unlike many platforms with heavy restrictions or complex workflows, Creen AI allows users to easily generate high-quality AI images and videos across a wide range of styles, empowering creativity without unnecessary barriers.

questions.title: Is Creen AI free to use?
questions.content: Yes. Creen AI offers free access to AI image and video generation features, allowing users to explore creative possibilities and experiment with visual ideas before choosing advanced or premium options.

questions.title: Do I need to sign up or log in?
questions.content: No sign-up is required to start creating. You can instantly generate AI images and videos without an account. Creating an account allows you to save projects, manage creations, and access additional features.

questions.title: Can I generate both images and videos with Creen AI?
questions.content: Absolutely. Creen AI supports AI image generation as well as AI video creation, including transforming images into animated or cinematic video content, enabling rich visual storytelling.

questions.title: What styles and use cases does Creen AI support?
questions.content: Creen AI supports a wide range of styles, including artistic illustrations, character design, realistic visuals, cinematic scenes, and creative concept art. It is suitable for artists, content creators, designers, and anyone exploring AI-powered visuals.

questions.title: Is my content private and secure?
questions.content: Yes. We take privacy seriously. Your generated images and videos are securely handled, and your creative data is protected. We do not share private user content with third parties.

questions.title: Can I create and customize my own visual concepts?
questions.content: Yes. Creen AI allows you to customize prompts, styles, and creative parameters to build unique visual concepts. You can experiment freely and refine your creations to match your vision.

questions.title: Who is Creen AI designed for?
questions.content: Creen AI is designed for everyone — from beginners exploring AI creativity to professional creators seeking powerful tools for image and video generation. No prior experience is required.

monthlyVsAnnual.question: What's the difference between monthly and annual billing?
monthlyVsAnnual.answer:
Features are identical — only price differs. Annual saves 40%: Pro is $29 / month on monthly, or about $14.5 / month ($174 / year) on annual.

Switch anytime from creen.ai/subscriptions. Monthly → annual switches immediately (see "How does upgrading work?" for how the charge is prorated). Annual → monthly takes effect at the end of your current annual cycle.

creditsRollOver.question: How do credits work? Do they roll over?
creditsRollOver.answer:
Credits are spent on every generation — cost depends on model, resolution, and duration, and is always shown before you confirm.

Plan credits and Credits Pack credits follow different rules:

  • Plan subscription credits — refresh to your plan's monthly allowance every cycle. They don't roll over — any unused credits are replaced when the new cycle starts.REFRESH MONTHLY
  • Credits Pack credits — every purchase is added to your balance and never expires. Buying a new Pack on top of an existing balance simply stacks more credits.ACCUMULATE FOREVER

If you have both, plan credits are spent first, then Credits Pack credits — keeping your non-expiring Pack balance intact for as long as possible.

Example: Sam subscribes to Pro on March 7 with 8,000 credits. By April 1 he's used 5,000. On April 7 his balance refreshes to 8,000 (not 11,000) — Plan credits reset, they don't accumulate. Pack credits would have stacked.

creditsPack.question: How does the Credits Pack work? What's the bonus structure?
creditsPack.answer:
Credits Pack is a monthly auto-renewing credit subscription, separate from and independent of your plan. Each month it charges your chosen tier and tops up your balance (like all credits on Creen, Pack credits accumulate and never expire).

Base rate is $10 / month for 3,000 credits. Bigger monthly tiers earn a bigger bonus — the higher your monthly commitment, the lower your per-credit price. If you only need credits and don't need a plan's features, subscribing to a Pack alone is the most cost-effective option.

Price / monthBonusCredits / month
$10—3,000
$30+10%9,900
$60+15%20,700
$100+20%36,000
$150+30%58,500
$300+40%126,000
$600+50%270,000

$100/month effectively saves 20% vs base rate; $600/month saves 50% — Creen's best per-credit tier.

subscriberBonus.question: Do paid subscribers get extra bonus on Credits Packs?
subscriberBonus.answer: Yes. On top of the pack-size bonus, paid subscribers get a tier-based bonus on every Credits Pack — the higher your subscription tier, the bigger the bonus. Ultra reaches +20% (effectively 20% off all credit top-ups), stacked on the pack-size bonus.

upgrading.question: How does upgrading work?
upgrading.answer:
Upgrading takes effect immediately. You're charged the prorated difference between your old and new plan (handled by Stripe automatically), and your new plan's features unlock right away.

Credits are topped up smartly to prevent double-dipping: we add (new plan's monthly allowance) − (credits you've already used this cycle) to your balance.

Example: You're on Pro (8,000 / month) and have used 3,000 this cycle. You upgrade to Max (20,000 / month). We add 20,000 − 3,000 = 17,000 credits to your balance, so your monthly total accounts to Max's full allocation.

Your billing date does not change for a tier upgrade — Stripe keeps your current cycle anchor, and the next charge is the new plan's full price.

Switching monthly → annual is the exception: you're charged the annual price minus the monthly fee already paid this cycle (e.g. Pro annual $174 − $29 already paid = $145), and a fresh annual cycle starts — your renewal date moves to one year out.

downgrading.question: How does downgrading work?
downgrading.answer:
Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle. You keep your current plan's full benefits and credits until then. No prorated refund is issued — you're already paying for what you have.

At the next renewal, your subscription automatically switches to the lower plan and starts charging the lower price. Until then, you can cancel the scheduled downgrade anytime from creen.ai/subscriptions.

cancelPlan.question: How do I cancel my plan or Credits Pack?
cancelPlan.answer:
Manage both at creen.ai/subscriptions. Your plan and Credits Pack are two independent subscriptions — cancel either one alone, or both together; one does not affect the other.

After cancellation:

  • Plan subscription — monthly access continues to the end of the current month; annual to the end of the year. After the plan expires, unused plan credits reset to 0 and your account reverts to the free tier.
  • Credits Pack — no further charges after the current pack cycle ends; all Pack credits already in your balance stay forever.

Cancel at least 5 days before your renewal date to avoid the next charge.

Changed your mind? Resubscribe before the cycle ends to keep everything going — no new charge, your current cycle continues uninterrupted.

creditsAfterCancel.question: What happens to my credits when I cancel?
creditsAfterCancel.answer:
Different rules for the two credit types:

  • Plan subscription credits — unused credits expire when your current cycle ends. The balance resets to 0 and you fall back to the free tier.USE OR LOSE
  • Credits Pack credits — never expire. They stay in your balance forever, regardless of plan cancellation, downgrade, or payment lapse.YOURS FOREVER

Your generations, history, and saved assets stay on your account untouched as well.
